name: iptv-client
description: A legal, cross-platform, local-first IPTV client.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @streamline/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @streamline/web build
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @streamline/core test && corepack pnpm --filter @streamline/web test && node --test scripts/source-policy.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @streamline/core typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @streamline/web typecheck
scripts.check: corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm validate:sources
scripts.android:sync: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm --filter @streamline/android-tv run sync
